generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence; exact parcel relation is never inferred.

extra_examples.fact: A site currently in Flood Zone 1 may need to be treated as Flood Zone 2 where SFRA or flood-map evidence shows increased future river/sea risk.
extra_examples.gate: Requires exact site evidence and FRA.

extra_examples.fact: An FRA should be completed for development in Flood Zone 1 where site area is 1 hectare or more.
The LPA must consult the Environment Agency for relevant development within 20 metres of a main river.
The sequential test can be required where vulnerable elements are in Flood Zones 2/3, future flood zones or other identified flood-risk circumstances.
Standing advice generally seeks finished floor levels at least 600mm above the relevant ground, road or estimated flood level, subject to site-specific evidence.
extra_examples.gate: Design guidance, not proof a site can comply.

extra_examples.fact: Ancient woodland is land wooded continuously since at least 1600 and is treated as irreplaceable habitat.

extra_examples.ref: Ancient woodland direct and indirect effects
extra_examples.fact: Official standing advice requires decision makers to assess direct and indirect development effects on ancient woodland and veteran trees.

extra_examples.ref: Protected-site requests moved to Defra Forms
extra_examples.fact: Natural England made Defra Forms the primary submission route for protected-site requests from 20 April 2026.

extra_examples.ref: Listed-building points are not legal extents
extra_examples.fact: Planning Data states listed-building data shows a point within the building and does not define the extent affected by the listing.
extra_examples.gate: Do not create parcel intersection from a point alone.

extra_examples.ref: Listed-building outlines are not reliable curtilage
extra_examples.fact: Planning Data states listed-building outlines are incomplete and do not consistently show planning curtilage.
extra_examples.gate: Exact legal curtilage requires further checks.
